items.text: Donating blood is simple, easy, & essential. The wellbeing of thousands of patients in our communities is dependent on the faithful giving of blood donors like you. So, if you are healthy, go to https://t.co/R785hiyk3y & make an appointment today. @CenCABlood #CA21 #5GallonClub https://t.co/NHeWyzccqi

Thank you to Kings Community Action Organization for giving me a tour of their food bank in Lemoore this week. Enjoyed learning more about their food delivery and nutrition education programs and future plans to continue helping our community. https://t.co/gS9icGbQjT

August is #ValleyFeverAwareness Month and an important reminder to talk to your doctor if you’re experiencing lingering symptoms such as fever, cough, fatigue, and body aches.

Learn more about Valley Fever prevention & symptoms: https://t.co/DOuYmzTpFc

Counties in the Central Valley rely on property tax revenue from the oil and gas industry to fund vital public services like public schools, hospitals, and law enforcement.

The rushed removal of this industry would be devastating to our local economy. 
https://t.co/RJR3gYyyLT

Congratulations to the congressional team for their win last night at the annual Women’s Congressional Softball Game and for raising over $540,000 for breast cancer patients under 40!🥎https://t.co/Fwqsou3s02

Today #CongressGoesPurple to celebrate the 22 million Americans in recovery from substance use disorder & show our support for those still struggling with addiction. 

If you or someone you know is struggling with mental health or substance use, visit https://t.co/kU7Pcd1rIC https://t.co/qPR4ZhMUYO

I’m 1 donation away from being a 6 gallon donor! The wellbeing of thousands of patients in the Valley is dependent on blood donors. If you’re able to, stop by the Shaw and Palm parking lot in Fresno for the @KMJNOW blood drive. https://t.co/fzb1fNLQlB

As a father of 3, the rise in mental health issues among young people is a big concern to me. 

Proud to join @RepKManning to introduce the Improving Mental Health &  Wellness in Schools Act to educate students about the importance of maintaining their mental and physical health.

I’m proud to support the Invest to Protect Act, which would provide grants for mental health services, treatments and therapy for the police officers of small communities like ours. If you or a loved one need help, call 9-8-8 or visit https://t.co/7DnojHLR1C

I’m proud to introduce a bipartisan resolution that would designate November 12, 2023, as CJD Awareness Day to honor long-time Bakersfield Mayor Harvey Hall’s memory & help raise awareness for CJD patients and their families across the country. https://t.co/PtvZBAchBt

As we approach Veterans Day, I'm highlighting some of the bills I support to ensure our veterans in #CA22 have access to the benefits & services they deserve.

The TREAT PTSD Act would expand the amount of PTSD treatment options available through the VA. #VeteransWeek https://t.co/Z4dnOFUm6z

Today is National Rural Health Day. Expanding access to quality healthcare for rural areas is essential, which is why I’ve been proud to support legislation to increase funding for rural health clinics, address doctor and nurse shortages, and expand telehealth services.

I’m proud to co-sponsor the Investing in Rural America Act, which would make it easier for Farm Credit Institutions to partner with USDA & community banks to invest in important community facility projects like senior care centers and rural hospitals. #CA22 https://t.co/J9ZSvRfaeT

The opioid epidemic continues to have a devastating impact on communities here in the Central Valley. 

I’m proud that the House just passed my bipartisan bill to better meet the needs of individuals struggling with substance abuse & mental health. https://t.co/gco4ZWCZte

We must ensure hospitals in our rural and underserved communities have the resources they need to provide high-quality care for Central Valley residents.

Proud to introduce this bipartisan bill with @RepLoriTrahan to support many of our hospitals in #CA22.

We need to address the root cause of homelessness in California to get people off the streets.

That’s why I’m supporting the Treatment and Homelessness Housing Integration Act, which will help get people into a treatment program and turn their lives around. https://t.co/nfwk1WOYsp

Veterans need to be confident the medical care they receive at the VA is actually what's best for their health – not what’s best for private contractors looking to increase profits. I led my colleagues in a letter to the VA to get answers for our veterans. https://t.co/cRar0Q857Z

We must ensure our servicemembers have reliable access to medical care.

I brought concerns over community healthcare access for servicemembers to the attention of our military leaders in today’s @HouseAppropsGOP hearing ⬇️

https://t.co/xDi5hrDAeM

Supplemental oxygen is a lifeline for so many people, but too many struggle to access the oxygen that works best for their lifestyle. 

The SOAR Act makes it easier for people to get the oxygen treatment they need to live healthy, active lives. Read more:  https://t.co/yFlxdTgHzz

This morning I joined the Delano Public Works Director & city officials to tour a water treatment facility and learn more about their plans for Well 42.

I helped Delano secure $6 million for the Well 42 Project, which will help provide clean, reliable water to Delano residents. https://t.co/rO5oeJ6Mb8

I recently visited the DaVita dialysis center in Hanford to learn about the life-saving work at their facility. I spoke with staff to discuss some of the challenges their patients face and how I can best support them in Congress. https://t.co/yuQmjGQ7H5

Enjoyed touring the new Kern County Adult & Youth Psychiatric Health Facilities in Bakersfield with director Alison Burrowes and her team. It was great to learn about the services and programs that will be offered for the community in this new facility. https://t.co/TIK4ahtzx5

It was great visiting the Bakersfield American Indian Health Project yesterday. I met with @BakersfieldAme1 CEO Angel Galvez & his team to learn more about their crucial work supporting the Native American community in Kern County. https://t.co/EflwC9aFGA

Today I introduced a bipartisan resolution that would designate November 12th as Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease Awareness Day to honor long-time Bakersfield Mayor Harvey Hall & help raise awareness for CJD patients and their families across the country. https://t.co/n62OYzbZwi

Was great meeting with Kerry Hydash, President and CEO of Family Healthcare Network. I heard about the challenges they face in the healthcare industry and learned of their work to assist low-income patients with their food pantry. https://t.co/c4jCQ72gwm
